precompile: <REQUIRED: replace with an object such as {"argv": ["python3", "precompile.py", "kernels.py"], "timeout_seconds": 1800} when the task compiles anything; delete the precompile key if it compiles nothing>
gpus: <REQUIRED: JSON array of nvidia-smi GPU indices or full GPU UUIDs, e.g. [0, 1]; use [] for a CPU-only task>

environment.venv: <REQUIRED: absolute path of the remote venv, e.g. /opt/venvs/tune; delete the venv key if none>

required_outputs: <REQUIRED: keys run.py must put in outputs, e.g. best_config>
